title: Compute average experimental parameters
action: Given the published reduced parameters (T_m/D, ΔH_fus/D, ε0/D) for Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, compute their arithmetic means to obtain the experimental average input parameters.
description: Compute the three average reduced parameters from the individual gas data. This step is required to produce the inputs for the subsequent scored step.

title: Compute vacancy interaction parameters
action: Using the average parameters from Step 1 and assuming the vacancy interaction potential V(v/n)=C[exp(-α n/v)-exp(-k α n/v)] and statistical weight g(v)=1 + a v/n, solve the model equations to determine x_liq, F_x_liq, x_min, α, n/v_liq, V(v_liq/n), a, g(v_liq), C for integer parameters k = 2, 3, 6, 10.
description: Array of objects, one per k value. Each object contains the computed parameters: k (int), x_liq (float), F_x_liq (float), x_min (float), alpha (float), n_over_v_liq (float), V_v_liq_n (float), a (float), g_v_liq (float), C (float). All values are dimensionless or in units of the pair well depth D.
output_schema: Array of objects with fields: k (int), x_liq (float), F_x_liq (float), x_min (float), alpha (float), n_over_v_liq (float), V_v_liq_n (float), a (float), g_v_liq (float), C (float).
